#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

struct Modulo {
    ll mod;
    Modulo(ll mod) : mod(mod) {}

    ll plus(ll a, ll b) const {
        ll c = a + b;
        if (c >= mod) c -= mod;
        return c;
    }

    ll minus(ll a, ll b) const {
        ll c = a - b;
        if (c < 0) c += mod;
        return c;
    }

    ll times(ll a, ll b) const {
        return (a * b) % mod;
    }

    ll pow(ll a, ll b) const {
        ll res = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if (b & 1) res = (res * a) % mod;
            a = (a * a) % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    ll divide(ll a, ll b) const {
        return times(a, pow(b, mod - 2));
    }

    ll combination(int n, int k, const vector<ll>& facts) const {
        if (k < 0 || k > n) return 0;
        return divide(facts[n], times(facts[k], facts[n - k]));
    }

    vector<ll> factorials(int n) const {
        vector<ll> f(n + 1);
        f[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) f[i] = (f[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        return f;
    }
};

void solve() {
    int n;
    ll k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    const ll MOD = 998244353;

    if (k >= n) {
        cout << 0 << '\n';
        return;
    }

    int kInt = (int)k;
    Modulo mod(MOD);
    vector<ll> fact = mod.factorials(n);

    ll ans = 0;
    int c = n - kInt;
    for (int i = 0; i <= c; ++i) {
        ll term = mod.times(mod.combination(c, i, fact), mod.pow(c - i, n));
        if ((i & 1) == 0) {
            ans = mod.plus(ans, term);
        } else {
            ans = mod.minus(ans, term);
        }
    }
    ans = mod.times(ans, mod.combination(n, n - kInt, fact));
    if (kInt > 0) {
        ans = mod.times(ans, 2LL);
    }
    cout << ans << '\n';
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    solve();
    return 0;
}
